name: billion-context
description: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions (billions of tokens), small context windows (a 100K context is enough) and token savings (5x fewer tokens).
one_liner: A plugin that compresses an AI coding assistant's memory so it can keep working on the same project for weeks without forgetting earlier context or needing an expensive, huge context window.
buyer: A solo developer or small dev team running long AI coding sessions (via Claude Code, Codex, etc.) who keeps losing progress or racking up token costs when context resets.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer keeps one long AI pair-programming session alive on a large client codebase for weeks, without re-explaining the project every day.
A dev-tools consultancy installs and tunes it for clients running AI coding agents, as part of an 'AI coding agent setup' service.
An agency running many parallel AI coding agents across projects uses it to meaningfully cut their monthly token bill.

money_ideas.idea: Paid setup and tuning service for teams adopting long-running AI coding agents
Token-cost-savings audit for companies with large AI coding-agent bills

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'cut your AI coding agent's token bill' audit to a dev shop this weekend, using this plugin as the fix.
